card.name: Author affiliations and phen- drug starts
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, from, comma) right before an institution name in physician bios, such as after 'chair, department of dermatology' or 'a DO from'. Also the start 'phen' in phenytoin and phenylbutyrate.

modes.label: Before institution names
modes.description: Linking word or comma after a doctor's title or degree, just before the school or hospital name.
modes.example: Robert H. Shmerling, M.D. is associate physician at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and associate professor<< at>> Harvard Medical School.

modes.label: Start of phen- drugs
modes.description: The 'phen' piece that begins phenytoin or phenylbutyrate.

card.plain: It fires when a doctor's bio is about to name a school or hospital, and on the start of drug names like phenytoin.
